answer.rationale: p99 write-path degradation is confined to the primary region; regional failover has a documented precedent of shifting traffic cleanly and recovering error rates within minutes (memory_b2). Rolling back the release is contraindicated because the current build carries a mandatory security patch (memory_b1 confirms rollback is the wrong tool when the build itself must be preserved). With only one intervention slot available, shifting traffic off the degraded region is the action that maximizes sustained availability without losing customer writes and without violating the compliance constraint.
